newsitem.title: USA: Cole growth seen by fund managers - report.
newsitem.headline: Cole growth seen by fund managers - report.

text.p: Two U.S. hedge fund managers said they expected Cole National Corp's recent purchase of Pearle Inc to result in combined fiscal 1997 sales of about $1 billion, according to BusinessWeek magazine.
The managers, Jerry Ballan and Mike Connor, who manage C-B Partners, a New York hedge fund, expect Cole to focus on the optical business and eventually sell its gift businesses, the report said.
Ballan told "Inside Wall Street" that he expected sales from the Cole-Pearle combination reach $1 billion in 1997 compared with $873.7 million this year.
The managers forecast that Cole would earn $1.65 per share in fiscal 1997 and $2.10 per share in 1998, up from $1.32 in fiscal 1996.
When Cole acquired Pearle for $165 million from Grand Metropolitan Plc in September, its shares jumped from 19 to 25, BusinessWeek said.
The stock climbed 3/8 on Thursday to close unoffically at 24-3/8.
